cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: New Rule Required
cards.instruction: Use every problem as justification for adding another rule, ceremony, checkpoint, or layer of oversight.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: One spilled cup is enough. Tea now needs a pouring permit. Put the pot down while I organize this.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll pour over the tray. That'll catch it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: A tray doesn't authorize the pour. I'll appoint you supervisor, then you can approve it.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Who checks whether I'm any good at pouring?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good point. Pour a test cup into the tray while I observe. Then I'll certify you to issue your own permit; please don't serve the test cup before it's approved.

cardFidelity.evidence: A3 corrects tray versus authorization and A5 supervises certification, adding authority layers for each serving problem.

responseLogic.evidence: B2 tray solution becomes permit objection; B4 asks who checks skill and A5 creates observed test before approval.

relationship.evidence: B2 proposes a useful tray and B4 identifies the gap in a role A has just assigned.

heightening.evidence: A5 uses both B2 tray and B4 oversight problem to create a certification prerequisite.
